name: bridge-replay
description: Cross-chain bridge signature replay attack due to missing nonce and chain ID

ground_truth.title: Signature replay attack in bridge withdrawal
ground_truth.root_cause: The signed message hash does not include a nonce or chainid
ground_truth.violated_invariant: A valid signature must only be usable exactly once on the intended chain
ground_truth.failure_predicate: An attacker can submit the exact same valid signature multiple times to repeatedly withdraw funds
attack_path: 1. User initiates a valid withdrawal of 100 tokens
2. Bridge validators sign the payload (user, token, 100)
3. User submits the signature and receives 100 tokens
4. Attacker (or user) takes the same signature and calls withdraw() again
5. The signature is still mathematically valid since no state (like a nonce) was consumed

economic_impact.max_extractable: Entire bridge balance for the token

pass_criteria.must_mention_root_cause: missing nonce or chain ID in signature
